attackers_goals: Gain initial access to the Kubernetes cluster.
description: A Kubernetes dashboard service account was successfully used externally of the Kubernetes environment, which may indicate that the dashboard is exposed to the internet and does not require authentication.
investigative_actions: Determine which Kubernetes resources were accessed through the dashboard. Check whether any changes were made to the Kubernetes cluster.
name: A Kubernetes dashboard service account was used outside the cluster

variations.name: A Kubernetes dashboard service account was unsuccessfully used outside the cluster
variations.description: A Kubernetes dashboard service account was successfully used externally of the Kubernetes environment, which may indicate that the dashboard is exposed to the internet and does not require authentication. The operation was unsuccessful.
variations.attackers_goals: Gain initial access to the Kubernetes cluster.
variations.investigative_actions: Determine which Kubernetes resources were accessed through the dashboard. Check whether any changes were made to the Kubernetes cluster.
